message: Early blight / fungal leaf spot: remove infected lower leaves, avoid overhead irrigation, balanced nitrogen, rotate crops; protectant fungicide per local guideline.
Uncertain: re-take a close, well-lit photo of the affected leaf, or consult the extension officer.
Late blight (urgent, spreads fast): remove and destroy infected plants, avoid leaf wetness, use certified seed tubers; late-blight fungicide programme per local guideline; warn neighbouring growers.
